in_marathi.name: Shaambhurekha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shaambhurekha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shaambhurekha is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Shaambhu' meaning god and 'Ikha' meaning wealth. Thus, Shaambhurekha is the Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Shaambhurekha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Shaambhurekha is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Shaambhu' meaning god and 'Ikha' meaning wealth. Thus, Shaambhurekha is the Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity.
